scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run fastapi dev
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: cd apps/api && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.test:api:db: cd apps/api && DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=5433 DB_NAME=postgres DB_USER=postgres DB_PASSWORD=postgres DB_SSLMODE=disable uv run pytest
